brief:
UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres expressed deep regret at Washington's refusal to grant a visa to Palestinian leader Mahmoud Abbas for the second consecutive year, a UN spokesperson said Friday, according to Middle East Eye. The denial prevents Abbas from attending the annual UN General Assembly meeting in New York.

The visa rejection marks a continuing diplomatic tension between the United States and the Palestinian Authority. Abbas's absence from the gathering represents a significant obstacle to Palestinian participation in the world body's most prominent annual forum.

title: UN chief regrets US visa denial for Palestinian leader Abbas
